# 3.-Custom formatting

Numbered wiki page title fixture.

## Custom format strings

| Flag | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `%v` | message text |
| `%l` | level name |

Example with nested fenced code:

````md
```cpp
spdlog::set_pattern("[%H:%M:%S] [%l] %v");
```
````
